sentence_stem: If I had studied harder last year,
correct_completion: I would be ready for the exam now.
full_sentence: If I had studied harder last year, I would be ready for the exam now.
acceptable_variants: I would have a better job today.
I would not be so worried now.

options.text: I am going to study tonight.
options.why_wrong: This is a plan for the future, not the present result of a past condition.
This describes a past action, but the sentence needs a present result after the if-clause.

options.text: I would be ready for the exam now.
I will have a test on Monday.
options.why_wrong: This states a fact about the future and does not complete the conditional result.

grammar_focus: Mixed conditionals: past condition with a present result
explanation: Mixed conditionals connect a past condition with a present result. Use had plus past participle in the if-clause and would plus base verb in the main clause, with now to show the present result.
translation: Gdybym w zeszłym roku uczył się ciężej, teraz byłbym gotowy do egzaminu.
